source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, Shopify had approximately 7,600 employees worldwide.

notes: Employees: year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll is null: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or other personnel costs (it describes personnel-related costs only as components of cost of revenues and operating expenses, and gives year-over-year changes in 'employee-related costs'), and Shopify, a foreign private issuer, files no proxy, so its 10-K/A Part III has no CEO pay ratio and no median employee pay.
